name: Local Implicit Ray Function (LIRF) Rendering
definition: A rendering technique that constructs each target ray by aggregating information from a cone (represented by vertices) rather than a single ray, allowing for multi-scale novel view synthesis and better handling of thin structures.
summary: Local Implicit Ray Function Rendering aggregates features within a conical frustum via a continuous implicit function, enabling multi-scale novel view synthesis and better handling of thin structures than standard ray casting.
